heading: EXT. GOBLIN MARKET UNDER THE BRIDGE - NIGHT

units.text: EXT. GOBLIN MARKET UNDER THE BRIDGE - NIGHT
Lantern-lit stalls strung beneath a river bridge.
Jars of bottled thunder.
Barrels of live shadows.
Everywhere, bargaining.
THIMBLE, a spindly goblin in a tin hat, hawks pocket-sized moons.
SABLE OOLONG, a heron-tall witch, weighs a nightingale on a brass scale.
GRIMBALD, a wide troll in an apron, stirs something orange.
NETTLE, a girl of twelve in patched trousers, slips between legs with a stolen apple.
PERPETUA, a thin moth-winged woman, folds her wings behind a stall of lace.
A bell clangs.
Every head turns.
Down the steps comes a knight in black lacquer armor, visor down, sword drawn: SIR HOLLOWAY, helm tilted, one boot leaving silver prints on the stones.
Thimble drops a moon.
Sable lifts the nightingale to her shoulder.
Grimbald whips the spoon like a mace.
By order of the Queen Under Glass, this market is closed!
units.name: SIR HOLLOWAY

units.text: You can't close a market!
units.name: THIMBLE

units.text: You'll close your own mouth first!
units.name: GRIMBALD

units.text: Nettle darts under Holloway's arm and bites the apple.
He swats.

Thimble hurls a moon, which bursts in his visor in a cloud of silver dust, and Sable swings a barrel of shadows, which smacks his shoulder, and Perpetua spreads her wings and sweeps a table of lace into his face, and the knight staggers, sword flailing, as Nettle ducks and the whole market rushes in, goblins, trolls and witches piling onto the armor.
Get his legs!
units.name: NETTLE

units.text: The knight topples.
A pile of stalls collapses.
Lace, moons, shadows, apples, all in a heap.
The bell clangs again, once, softly, and stops.
You have made a grave mistake.
units.name: SIR HOLLOWAY

units.text: Sir, we make them daily.
units.name: SABLE
